t: # Short Obligatory Prayer ## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon. Ndi njadika, Wewe Mvidi-Mukulu wanyi, ne wakamfuta bua kukumanya ne bua kukutendelela. Ndi njadika mu tshitupa tshihi emu, bufuba buanyi ne bukole Buebe, bupele buanyi ne bubanji Buebe. Kakuena Muidi-Mukulu mukuabo bu Wewe, M-Muambuluishi wa mu Dikenga, Nyeye udi wikalaku anu Yeye-Nkayende.
